title: CppCon 2016: Chandler Carruth “High Performance Code 201: Hybrid Data Structures"
summary: Chandler Carruth's CppCon 2016 talk on designing hybrid data structures for performance. He covers cache locality, working-set size and allocation overhead, and why standard C++ containers fall short.
why: Cited as the source for criticism of std::deque and move-constructor pitfalls, and as motivation to write custom data structures.
